-- stg payments dedupe
-- owner: olena.kravets@acme.co
-- created: 2023-02-06
-- feeds every revenue report
SELECT
    payment_id, order_id, subscription_id, user_id, amount_minor, currency, status, processor, attempt_no, is_rebill, created_at, settled_at, refunded_at, updated_at, ingested_at
FROM (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY payment_id
            ORDER BY updated_at DESC, ingested_at DESC
        ) AS _rn
    FROM `acme-analytics-prod.raw.payments`
    WHERE DATE(created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY)
)
WHERE _rn = 1

-- stg fx daily fill-forward
-- owner: olena.kravets@acme.co
-- created: 2023-02-20
WITH spine AS (
  SELECT rate_date
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY('2022-01-01', CURRENT_DATE())) AS rate_date
),
currencies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM `acme-analytics-prod.raw.fx_rates`
)
SELECT
    spine.rate_date,
    currencies.currency,
    fx.rate_to_usd,
    LAST_VALUE(fx.rate_to_usd IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
        PARTITION BY currencies.currency
        ORDER BY spine.rate_date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS last_known_rate
FROM spine
CROSS JOIN currencies
LEFT JOIN `acme-analytics-prod.raw.fx_rates` fx
    ON fx.rate_date = spine.rate_date
   AND fx.currency = currencies.currency

-- Revenue daily (main)
-- owner: olena.kravets@acme.co
-- created: 2022-04-11
-- reads staging, must run after stg_payments
WITH
pay AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY payment_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC, ingested_at DESC) AS _rn
    FROM `acme-analytics-prod.staging.stg_payments`
  )
  WHERE _rn = 1
),
subs AS (
  SELECT subscription_id, user_id, plan_id, tier, billing_period_days, country_code
  FROM `acme-analytics-prod.staging.stg_subscriptions`
  WHERE NOT COALESCE(is_test, FALSE)
)
SELECT
    DATE(p.created_at) AS payment_date,
    s.country_code,
    CASE
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('US','CA') THEN 'NA'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('GB','DE','FR','IT','ES','NL','PL','PT','SE','IE') THEN 'EU'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('BR','MX','AR','CL','CO') THEN 'LATAM'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('JP','KR','TW','SG','TH','PH','ID') THEN 'APAC'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('TR','AE','SA','IL','ZA') THEN 'EMEA'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS region,
    s.tier,
    s.billing_period_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_id) AS payments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS payers,
    SUM(p.amount_minor / 100.0 * COALESCE(fx.rate_to_usd, fx.last_known_rate, 1.0)) AS revenue_usd
FROM pay p
JOIN subs s
    ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
LEFT JOIN `acme-analytics-prod.staging.stg_fx_daily` fx
    ON fx.rate_date = DATE(p.created_at)
   AND fx.currency = p.currency
WHERE DATE(p.created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY)
  AND p.status = 'settled'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

-- Revenue daily hourly topup
-- owner: dmytro.shevchuk@acme.co

    processor,
    status,
    attempt_no,
    COUNT(*) AS attempts,

    SUM(amount_minor) / 100.0 AS amount_local,

WHERE DATE(created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

-- LTV by cohort
-- owner: olena.kravets@acme.co
-- created: 2022-11-08
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT
      DATE(s.activated_at) AS cohort_date,
      s.subscription_id,
      s.user_id,
      s.tier,
      s.billing_period_days,
      s.country_code,
      CASE
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('US','CA') THEN 'NA'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('GB','DE','FR','IT','ES','NL','PL','PT','SE','IE') THEN 'EU'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('BR','MX','AR','CL','CO') THEN 'LATAM'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('JP','KR','TW','SG','TH','PH','ID') THEN 'APAC'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('TR','AE','SA','IL','ZA') THEN 'EMEA'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS region
  FROM `acme-analytics-prod.raw.subscriptions` s
  WHERE s.status = 'active'
    AND s.activated_at IS NOT NULL
    AND DATE(s.activated_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 540 DAY)
),
rev AS (
  SELECT
      p.subscription_id,
      SUM(p.amount_minor / 100.0 * COALESCE(fx.rate_to_usd, fx.last_known_rate, 1.0)) AS revenue_usd,
      COUNT(*) AS charges
  FROM `acme-analytics-prod.raw.payments` p
  LEFT JOIN `acme-analytics-prod.staging.stg_fx_daily` fx
    ON fx.rate_date = DATE(p.created_at)
   AND fx.currency = p.currency
  WHERE p.status = 'settled'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    c.cohort_date,
    c.region,
    c.tier,
    c.billing_period_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.subscription_id) AS subscriptions,
    SUM(r.revenue_usd) AS revenue_usd,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(r.revenue_usd), COUNT(DISTINCT c.subscription_id)) AS ltv_usd,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(r.charges), COUNT(DISTINCT c.subscription_id)) AS charges_per_sub
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN rev r USING (subscription_id)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

-- Marketing spend daily
-- owner: dmytro.shevchuk@acme.co
-- created: 2023-03-15
WITH raw_spend AS (
  SELECT
      spend_date,
      channel,
      campaign_id,
      country_code,
      currency,
      SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
      SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
      SUM(spend_minor) AS spend_minor
  FROM `acme-analytics-prod.raw.ad_spend`
  WHERE DATE(spend_date) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
),
prior AS (
  -- carry forward the FX-adjusted spend we already computed, so the report
  -- does not flip while today's rates are still missing
  SELECT spend_date, channel, campaign_id, country_code, spend_usd
  FROM `acme-analytics-prod.marketing.spend_enriched`
  WHERE spend_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
)
SELECT
    r.spend_date,
    r.channel,
    r.campaign_id,
    r.country_code,
    r.impressions,
    r.clicks,
    r.spend_minor,
    COALESCE(p.spend_usd, r.spend_minor / 100.0) AS spend_usd_provisional
FROM raw_spend r
LEFT JOIN prior p
    ON p.spend_date = r.spend_date
   AND p.channel = r.channel
   AND p.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
   AND p.country_code = r.country_code

-- User daily activity
-- owner: ihor.pavliuk@acme.co
-- created: 2025-01-20
SELECT
    DATE(r.read_ts) AS activity_date,
    r.user_id,
    COUNT(*) AS reads,
    SUM(r.minutes) AS minutes_read,
    COUNTIF(r.is_paid_episode) AS paid_reads,
    ANY_VALUE(seg.segment) AS segment_at_activity
FROM `acme-analytics-prod.raw.reads` r
LEFT JOIN `acme-analytics-prod.ml.user_segments` seg
    ON seg.user_id = r.user_id
WHERE DATE(r.read_ts) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)
GROUP BY 1, 2

-- User feature table
-- owner: ihor.pavliuk@acme.co
-- created: 2025-01-20
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
      user_id,
      MAX(activity_date) AS last_active_date,
      SUM(reads) AS reads_lifetime,
      SUM(minutes_read) AS minutes_lifetime,
      SUM(paid_reads) AS paid_reads_lifetime
  FROM `acme-analytics-prod.ml.user_daily`
  GROUP BY 1
),
seg AS (
  SELECT user_id, segment, segment_scored_at
  FROM `acme-analytics-prod.ml.user_segments`
)
SELECT
    b.user_id,
    b.last_active_date,
    b.reads_lifetime,
    b.minutes_lifetime,
    b.paid_reads_lifetime,
    DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), b.last_active_date, DAY) AS days_since_active,
    seg.segment AS previous_segment
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN seg ON seg.user_id = b.user_id

-- User segments
-- owner: ihor.pavliuk@acme.co
-- created: 2025-01-27
SELECT
    f.user_id,
    CASE
      WHEN f.days_since_active <= 3 AND f.paid_reads_lifetime >= 20 THEN 'core'
      WHEN f.days_since_active <= 7 THEN 'active'
      WHEN f.days_since_active <= 30 THEN 'lapsing'
      ELSE 'dormant'
    END AS segment,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS segment_scored_at
FROM `acme-analytics-prod.ml.user_features` f

      SUM(spend_minor) / 100.0 AS spend
  FROM `acme-analytics-prod.raw.ad_spend`
  WHERE DATE(spend_date) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
),
conv AS (
  SELECT
      DATE(u.registered_at) AS reg_date,
      u.acquisition_source AS channel,
      u.country_code,
      COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS registrations,
      COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS payers
  FROM `acme-analytics-prod.raw.users` u
  LEFT JOIN `acme-analytics-prod.raw.payments` p
      ON p.user_id = u.user_id
     AND p.status = 'settled'
  WHERE DATE(u.registered_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT
    s.spend_date,
    s.channel,
    CASE
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('US','CA') THEN 'NA'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('GB','DE','FR','IT','ES','NL','PL','PT','SE','IE') THEN 'EU'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('BR','MX','AR','CL','CO') THEN 'LATAM'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('JP','KR','TW','SG','TH','PH','ID') THEN 'APAC'
      WHEN s.country_code IN ('TR','AE','SA','IL','ZA') THEN 'EMEA'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS region,
    SUM(s.spend) AS spend,
    SUM(s.clicks) AS clicks,
    SUM(c.registrations) AS registrations,
    SUM(c.payers) AS payers,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(s.spend), SUM(c.payers)) AS cpa

  WHERE DATE(u.registered_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
